subject: Career of Actor Frankie Imbergamo
overview: Host Stevie B interviewed Medford resident Frankie Imbergamo about his career transition from the postal service to professional acting. They discussed Imbergamo's cookbook, his appearance on the Food Network with Emeril Lagasse, and his roles in over 50 motion pictures.

items.title: Introduction and Postal Service Background
items.summary: Host Stevie B introduced guest Frankie Imbergamo and discussed Imbergamo's former career as a manager and supervisor for the United States Postal Service in the Boston area.

items.title: Emeril's Italian Recipe Contest
items.summary: Imbergamo explained how winning a national cooking contest with his meatball recipe in 2004 led to his first television appearance and subsequent entry into the film industry.

items.title: Emeril Live Segment Footage
items.summary: The show presented a clip from the Food Network program Emeril Live featuring Imbergamo preparing his signature gravy recipe with chef Emeril Lagasse.

items.title: Acting Career and Celebrity Encounters
items.summary: Imbergamo recounted his experiences as a Screen Actors Guild member working on sets with actors such as Adam Sandler, Sandra Bullock, and Jeff Bridges.

items.title: Actor Demo Reel
items.summary: A video montage showcased Imbergamo's performances in various regional commercials and feature films.

items.title: DJ Stan the Man Production
items.summary: The guest discussed his lead role as a photographer in the independent film DJ Stan the Man and its local screening history.

items.title: Film Clips and Production Stories
items.summary: The program aired a clip from DJ Stan the Man followed by Imbergamo's anecdotes regarding Scarlett Johansson and the filming of American Hustle.

items.title: Pizza Makers Series and Union Benefits
items.summary: Imbergamo detailed his involvement in the web series Pizza Makers and discussed the pay scales and residual benefits associated with union acting work.

items.title: Upcoming Film Releases
items.summary: Imbergamo highlighted his roles in the films Chappaquiddick and The Catcher Was a Spy shortly before the program's conclusion.
